Welcome
This website hosts materials for DATA 422: Advanced Data Science Methods and Ethics (4 units) at Cal Poly Humboldt, Fall 2026.
Lecture: Monday, Wednesday, Friday, 11:00–11:50 a.m., NR 224 (DATA 422-10, Class Number 42778).
Lab: Tuesday, 11:00 a.m.–12:50 p.m., BSS 313 (DATA 422-11, Class Number 42779).
Project 3 presentations are Friday, December 18, 10:20 a.m.–12:10 p.m., NR 224.

What you will do

JIT: object-oriented Python for nn.Module (class, self, super(), forward).
RiskMLP shapes, parameter count, tiny-batch overfit.

Exercises print a desired shape, count, or accuracy so you can self-check.
